Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Follow-up + proposed eval kickoff slots

Thanks again for the great discovery call today - really appreciate the context on Acme's ingestion pipelines and the 2 main workloads you called out (support summarization + search re-ranking). Per our discussion, the next best step is a short evaluation kickoff where we can: 1) align on success criteria and data/traffic slices, 2) walk through the trial plan & responsibilities, and 3) schedule a technical deep-dive to scope infra and prompt/eval design.

Attached is a very small draft eval plan (ACME-eval-plan-connor-20270310.pdf) + our trial-scope template. Can you confirm which of these kickoff times works on your side?

- Option A: Tue Mar 16, 10:00-11:00 PT (kickoff + brief demo)
- Option B: Wed Mar 17, 08:00-09:00 PT (kickoff + technical deep dive)
- Option C: Thu Mar 18, 11:00-12:00 PT (kickoff + demo)

If none of those work, send a couple slots and we'll adapt. I'll loop in Marissa (Customer Success) and Neha (Solutions Eng) - Neha will run the technical deep-dive and prepare a recommended prompt set / initial eval examples.

Next steps: if you pick a slot, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
